title: Food planning: design
summary: Design and implementation contract for standalone reusable food plans: schema, plan-list link semantics, projection math, pack-state lifecycle, share DTO, caps, slicing, and nutrition targets.
scope: per-user caps and D1 param limits
notes: ADR/SPEC ambiguity resolved to SPEC: the doc carries ADR-style headers (Status/Date/Supersedes) and a numbered Decisions section (12.1-12.10), but it is a multi-decision technical specification (schemas, SQL contracts, API shapes, DTOs, required tests) rather than one locked decision. Header status is PROPOSED/'APPROVED in direction' while memory and in-doc revisions show most slices shipped; decisions are marked 'settled but revisable' and several were revised in place (12.9 superseded by 12.1; section 14 added 2026-07-18), so no locked flag applies. Also references ADR 12 by number without a path, plus old-repo migration files (code, excluded from cross_refs).
